trigger_or_context: Something about the relationship feels open or unknown.
short_term_function: Having a plan helps you feel in control and eases the not-knowing right now.
developmental_cost: You push for certainty faster than the relationship can give it, so you don't get to see how it goes on its own.
adaptive_alternative_1: When you feel the pull to plan it all, name what feels unknown. Then let one small thing stay open and watch what happens.
what_new_response_supports: You find out if you can sit with some not-knowing. You get to see how the other person acts on their own.
expected_discomfort_or_cost: The open feeling is uncomfortable. You may not like not having an answer yet.
context_conditions: Plans are useful at times. This is about when you need one for everything and can't leave room to see how things unfold.
review_reason: Cross-Phase source gap: no competency cleanly maps and there is no single developmental task. The maintaining role fits the control pattern; alternative is observation/discernment-style.

trigger_or_context: A relationship is moving along at its own pace.
review_reason: Names a difficulty, not a discrete alterable behavior. It describes the trouble letting things unfold but not what you actually do, so it is outcome-level.

trigger_or_context: Things are going okay, but you expect they could go wrong.
short_term_function: Bracing ahead of time softens the blow if things do go wrong, so it feels safer right now.
developmental_cost: You stay guarded and hold back, so you don't let the relationship be what it really is.
adaptive_alternative_1: When you catch yourself bracing, name what you are afraid will happen. Then watch what really happens instead of acting on the fear.
what_new_response_supports: You find out if the worry is real or just a habit of guarding. You get to see how things actually go.
expected_discomfort_or_cost: Staying open means you could be let down for real. That is a hard feeling to sit with.
context_conditions: Some caution is wise. This is about when you brace before there is any real sign of trouble.
review_reason: Cross-Phase source gap: no competency cleanly maps and there is no single developmental task. The maintaining role fits the control/self-protection pattern; alternative is observation-style.
